contracts: AnimationVM_RunActorPass supplies 0x00FF769A as the output cursor to the actor-sprite payload builder.
Render_BuildActorSpritePayload emits 14-byte VDP payload records and increments ACTOR_SPRITE_PAYLOAD_COUNT.
Render_SubmitActorSprites consumes payload records from 0x00FF769A using the published count.
limitations: The symbol identifies the buffer base but does not assert an unverified maximum buffer extent.
No separate semantic identity is assigned to individual payload records.
conclusion: The generated Unknown_00FF769A identity is replaced by the stable actor-sprite payload buffer base while preserving its producer/consumer contract.
